description_en: Queries all rules of an event bus
description_zh: 查询一个事件总线的所有规则
name: ListRules

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the rule name
parameters.name: rule_name_prefix

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to be returned in a single call. You can use this parameter and the NextToken parameter to implement paging. A maximum of 100 entries can be returned in a single call
parameters.help_zh:
限定每次返回的最大条数，可以和NextToken搭配使用实现翻页能力。
<notice>每次返回的最大条数不超过100。></notice>
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: If you set the Limit parameter and excess return values exist, this parameter is returned
parameters.help_zh: 当指定Limit时，如果还有多余的返回值则会返回NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the event bus
parameters.name: event_bus_name

Code.description_en:
The response code.

Success: The request was successful.
Other codes: The request failed. For more information about error codes, see Error codes
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。

Success：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误码

NextToken.description_en: If excess return values exist, this parameter is returned
NextToken.description_zh: 如果还有多余的返回值则会返回NextToken

DetailMap.description_en: The details of the event rule

EventBusName.description_en: The name of the event bus

FilterPattern.description_en:
The event pattern, in JSON format. Valid values:

stringEqual: Up to five expressions in the map data structure can be specified in each field.
stringExpression: Up to five expressions in the map data structure can be specified in each field
FilterPattern.description_zh:
事件模式，JSON格式。取值说明如下：

stringEqual模式：每个field最多5个expression（map结构）。
stringExpression模式：每个field最多5个expression（map结构）

RuleARN.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the rule

RuleName.description_en: The name of the event rule

Status.description_en:
The status of the event rule. Valid values:

ENABLE (default)
DISABLE
Status.description_zh:
规则的状态。取值说明如下：

ENABLE：规则已启用。规则默认状态。

DISABLE：规则已禁用

Endpoint.description_en: The endpoint of the event target

ErrorsTolerance.description_en:
The fault tolerance policy. Valid values:

ALL: Fault tolerance is allowed. If an error occurs in an event, event processing is not blocked. If the event fails to be sent after the maximum number of retries specified by the retry policy is reached, the event is delivered to the dead-letter queue or discarded based on your configurations.
NONE: Fault tolerance is prohibited. If an error occurs in an event and the event fails to be sent after the maximum number of retries specified by the retry policy is reached, event processing is blocked
ErrorsTolerance.description_zh:
容错策略。取值说明如下：

ALL：允许容错。允许异常容错，当异常发生时不会阻塞执行，超过重试策略后会根据配置将消息投递至死信队列或直接丢弃。
NONE：禁止容错。不允许容错，当异常发生并超过重试策略配置时会阻塞执行

Id.description_en: The ID of the custom event target

PushSelector.description_en: The transformer that is used to push events

Type.description_en: The type of the event target. For more information, see Event target parameters. (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/eventbridge/latest/event-target-parameters)
Type.description_zh: 事件目标类型。更多信息，请参见[事件目标参数]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185887.html）

Message.description_en: The error message that is returned if the request failed
Message.example: Specified parameter Limit is not valid.

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true and false
